_readme: Copy this file to schedule.json and put your own timetable in it.
schedule.json is in .gitignore, so what you write there stays on your disk.
Clawd re-reads it whenever it changes — no restart needed.
Right-click him -> 'edit schedule.json' opens it, 'today's briefing' shows it.
days  = any of mon tue wed thu fri sat sun
start = 24-hour HH:MM. He says something 25 minutes before one starts.
deadlines: one-off, and what he actually nags about.
due  = 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM', or 'YYYY-MM-DD' for the end of that day (23:59)
done = true makes him forget it without you deleting the line
Nagging order, worst first: overdue -> due today -> due within
deadline_horizon_days (config.json, default 3). One at a time, never a list.
todos: no date. He pokes you about a random one every todo_poke_hours.
The dates below are in the past on purpose, so a fresh copy nags at nobody.
